summary: Mid-sequence timeout during long streaming completion when large max_tokens triggers dynamic KV eviction
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports repeated HTTP 504 / client-side timeouts mid-stream when requesting very large generation budgets. This happens after ~60-120s into a streaming completion on requests with very large max_tokens (50k+) and a long priming context (>100k tokens).

Impact: Several API calls from AcmeHealth's dedicated pool abort mid-generation. The outputs are partial (stream stops) and the client observes a 504 or connection reset. This impacts an internal clinical note summarization pipeline; they see ~15% of jobs failing when running nightly batches.

Environment: Dedicated cluster for AcmeHealth in us-west (reserved capacity). Streaming endpoint via /v1/stream with HTTP/2. Observed on models listed above; primary repro uses redwood-alpha-13b-quant.

Observed behavior: Stream produces tokens for ~1-2 minutes, then stream stops and client receives timeout/504. On the server, finalizer logs show a "finalizer: stall waiting for KV chunk" followed by eviction notices and then a new kernel swap; no OOMs, but a spike in KV eviction and cache-rewrite timestamps. After eviction, the stream finalizer appears to fail to reattach KV state and leaves the session in a hung state until connection closes.

Expected behavior: Long streaming responses should either complete or be gracefully failed with a clear server-side error while preserving partial output. Eviction/GC should not break an in-flight streaming session.

Steps to reproduce: see repro_steps field.

Notes: Customer previously had a workaround by reducing max_tokens to 8k, which avoids the issue. They need guidance for a production-safe mitigation and an engineering fix.
repro_steps: 1) Use dedicated API key and call /v1/stream with model=redwood-alpha-13b-quant
2) Send a multi-document priming prompt producing ~110k tokens (concise but many documents), set max_tokens=60000, stream=true
3) Observe streaming tokens arrive for ~60-120s then the client receives a 504 or HTTP/2 RST_STREAM
4) Correlate server logs for the request_id returned in the initial 200 to find KV eviction and finalizer stall log lines
logs: [2026-03-12T08:14:22Z] request_id=req-0a7b2 Stream start: model=redwood-alpha-13b-quant, max_tokens=60000, prefix_tokens=112430
[2026-03-12T08:15:52Z] node-12 kv-cache: evict shard=12 chunk=43 reason=memory_pressure target_free=256MB
[2026-03-12T08:15:53Z] request_id=req-0a7b2 finalizer: kv-attachment failed: missing-chunk -> falling back to loader
[2026-03-12T08:15:53Z] request_id=req-0a7b2 kernel-swap: triggered swap to quantized-path, latency_penalty=310ms
[2026-03-12T08:16:25Z] request_id=req-0a7b2 http2: RST_STREAM received from client (code=11)
investigation_notes: 2026-03-12 — Support triage: confirmed reproducible in customer's dedicated pool. No infra-level node OOMs found in timeframe.
2026-03-12 — SRE: KV eviction spikes correlate with concurrent batch priming on the same GPU which increases memory churn.

2026-03-12 — Eng (serving-runtime): hypothesis: dynamic-kv-eviction race with stream finalizer attachment; when a needed KV chunk is evicted mid-sequence, the loader/fallback path can add significant latency and sometimes fails to resume streaming state cleanly.
2026-03-13 — Found increased kernel-swap count in affected requests; batching and prefetch heuristics appear to push eviction earlier for very deep prefixes.
Repro note: lowering max_tokens to <= 8192 or reducing concurrent priming reduces occurrence.
comments: 2026-03-12 Priya Nair (Support): Acknowledged receipt. Assigned to Marco. Asking for full request_id and sample prompt. — Status set to In Progress
2026-03-12 Customer (AcmeHealth - DataEng): Provided sample prompt and request_id=req-0a7b2. Noted incidence ~15% of nightly jobs fail when running large-batch summarization.

2026-03-12 Marco Silva (SRE): Captured node logs and KV eviction traces. No node OOM; eviction driven by memory_cgroup pressure from concurrent workloads. Recommending temporary limit on concurrent priming for this pool.

2026-03-13 Elena Park (ServRuntime Eng): Ran local repro harness with same prefix size; confirmed finalizer hang when chunk eviction is triggered. Patch candidate to add a deterministic reattach/retry path for finalizer. Opening PR for guarded re-fetch of evicted chunks.
2026-03-13 Marco Silva (SRE): Applied temporary quota change to customer's autoscaler to reduce concurrent priming jobs; customer reports immediate reduction in failures to <2%.
2026-03-13 Customer (AcmeHealth): Confirmed mitigation worked for nightly run. Asking for ETA on permanent fix and whether there are configuration knobs we can expose.

2026-03-13 Elena Park (ServRuntime Eng): PR drafted: runtime#9812. Work plan: harden finalizer reattach path (hotfix), add monitoring alert for eviction-during-stream (post-merge), and evaluate prefetch/retention tuning for dedicated pools (follow-up).
next_steps: 1) Merge hotfix PR for deterministic finalizer reattach (eng priority)
2) Add an SLO/alert for 'eviction-during-active-stream' on dedicated pools
3) Offer customer a config knob to limit concurrent priming or increase reserved KV retention for their pool (short-term)
4) Post-fix: run smoke tests with sample large-priming suite and schedule a rollback window
